meda.time_conventions: LMST = local mean solar time at the rover; sol numbers per Mars 2020 mission count; UTC from PDS4 label start/stop; Ls = areocentric solar longitude computed from UTC (Allison & McEwen 2000).

context.title: Earth–Mars communication delay
context.label: LIMITED
context.source: Computed d / c with c = 299,792.458 km/s; NASA outreach commonly quotes "4 to 24 minutes".
limitations: Actual latency depends on date and relay pass schedules; surface links need orbiter relays.
Solar conjunction constrains operations for a period; duration is mission-specific (not modelled here).
The plan therefore has to be decided locally; this tool works offline.
